description: Use when you need a published Sideline report card, the same cards as /report-cards. Optional week (1 to 18) or weekId (YYYY-wNN). Omit both for the newest published card. Returns that card and the season-to-date totals. Grades are historical. For the live weather call, use get_game.

week.description: Regular season week, 1 to 18. Omit for the newest published card.

weekId.description: Week id YYYY-wNN, for example 2026-w04. Omit for the newest published card.

name: get_report_card
title: Report card
